label: D-efec7b

defects.summary: Deviation 39 says the coder did not read the selected project rules in full and used the shape of nearby tests instead, but AGENTS.md says to read and apply them before changing any file.

MustCarryNoFlags also refuses a plan with CwdKind.Root and adds text to the decision-3 message, but deviation 36 lists only Leading, Flags and AddDirs, so the recorded deviation is incomplete and the extra test APlanRootedInTheCheckout_IsRefusedForKimi is outside the stories' scope.

Deviation 33 says the planner arm's own red (S5.6.3, S5.6.5, S5.6.6) was never watched, because the arm and the table went in one edit; this is against the plan's red-first rule, but the deviation states it honestly.
TheVectorsCoverKimi repeats the existing TheVectorsActuallyLoaded_AndCoverEveryPairOfTheTable test, which the spec names as S5.6.2 and which already covers every kimi pair.

The Scopes class and StandIn() are copied a second and a third time (here and in AKimiQuestionRowTests) from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests, instead of one shared helper, and Dispose resets KimiHome.AfterUnlink although the class never sets it.

S5.5.4 checks only that the --home parent ends with 'own'; it does not check that the parent is inside the check's coai-check-* scratch or that the home is named kh-<10 hex>, and S5.5.1 checks only a coai-vh prefix, not the <8> level.
S5.6.5 checks 'neither root named' only on the disk request's arguments, not on the none request and not on the prompt.

summary: The change delivers E5.5 and E5.6 as the spec says: a flag-free kimi planner arm (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none), the three rows with the decided standings and cells, the vectors, the regenerated TS table, the flagged-plan refusal, and all 12 scenarios present and green, with tests that have real teeth (the AsyncLocal recorder hole was found and closed). The findings are about process and housekeeping: the rules were admittedly not read in full, one deviation does not list the extra CwdKind.Root refusal, the planner arm's red was not watched, there is a redundant vector test, and the test helpers are copied.
